description: This file defines the Doctrine class responsible for configuring and providing access to the Doctrine ORM's EntityManager within the OrangeHRM application. It handles setup of database connections, cache configuration, and custom functions for ORM operations.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for initializing and providing access to the Doctrine ORM's EntityManager, handling ORM setup, cache configuration, and database connection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes Doctrine ORM configuration, cache, and database connection based on application configuration and environment.

methods.name: isDevMode
methods.description: Determines if the application is running in development mode by checking the debug status of the HTTP kernel service.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Compiles and returns an array of entity paths from plugin directories for ORM metadata configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern to instantiate and provide access to the Doctrine object.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine EntityManager instance used for database operations.
